resources.string: Friction watches when you open apps you chose to guard, and inserts a short breathing pause before they open. It never sends data off your device.
Four steps. Do all of them so Friction works after reboot.
Detects when a guarded app opens. Enable “Friction app guard”.
Required for the instant black pause screen over other apps.
Stops OEMs from killing Friction in the background. Set to Unrestricted / No restrictions.
Lets Friction run after phone restart without opening the app first. Critical on Xiaomi / HyperOS.

So Friction works after reboot without opening it first:

1. Tap “Open settings” below.
2. Find Friction in the list.
3. Turn Autostart / Auto-launch ON.

Xiaomi / HyperOS path if the button fails:
Settings → Apps → Manage apps → Friction → Autostart → On
Also: Battery saver → No restrictions.

Samsung: Device care → Battery → Background usage limits → Never sleeping apps → add Friction.
No apps guarded yet. Pick some below.
After the countdown you always get a Yes / No check: “Do you really want to open this?”
Do you really want to open %1$s?
Take a second. You can always come back later.
Finish setup above so Friction can run.
Accessibility is on in Settings but the service is not running. Tap to open Accessibility, turn Friction off and on again.
